name: Article 9, § 1, point e – 144
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on applying a generalised scheme of tariff preferences and repealing Regulation (EU) No 978/2012 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text: (e) it accepts the reporting requirements imposed by the core human and labour rights conventions and gives a binding undertaking to participate in regular monitoring and review with respect to those conventions;
